title: Ya and Todavía No with Food and Traditions

sections.content: Use ya to say that a preparation has been completed and todavía no to say that it remains unfinished. Combine these forms with food, drinks, dishes and traditions. The pretérito perfecto makes the connection with the present clear: Ya he preparado el plato, pero todavía no he comprado la bebida.

items.english: I have already prepared the dish.

items.spanish: Todavía no he comprado la bebida.
items.english: I have not bought the drink yet.
We have already prepared the food.

items.spanish: Todavía no hemos preparado la bebida.
items.english: We have not prepared the drink yet.

sections.content: Use ya for something completed and todavía no for something that has not happened yet.
